header.productTitle: SuperBrush Jr Manual Toothbrush for Kids
header.superHtml:
Introducing SuperMouth’s SuperBrush Jr. - a leap forward in children's oral care. Engineered with the same pioneering spirit that defines our adult range, this toothbrush is a fusion of fun and functionality, specially designed for young smiles.

Crafted after meticulously scanning a diverse range of children's teeth, the bristles conform flawlessly to every contour of your child’s teeth. Plus, it boasts over 8,000 ultra-soft, yet highly effective bristles, more than triple the standard count, making it gentle on tender gums and young teeth. Each stroke is designed to be fun and effective, ensuring a thorough clean that kids will love.

Available in a rainbow of vibrant colors and featuring exciting, kid-friendly designs, this toothbrush transforms routine brushing into an adventure. It's more than just a toothbrush; it's a playful companion in your child's oral hygiene journey.

Welcome to the new era of children's oral care with SuperMouth – where innovation, fun, and clean smiles meet.

  • Patent pending design: First major bristle innovation since 1938.
  • Tailored for children: Designed after scanning diverse children's teeth.
  • Triple the bristles: Over 8,000 ultra-soft bristles for gentle, effective cleaning.
  • Augmented Reality Sticker: ‘Tooth Keri’ – Your child’s interactive guide to proper brushing and flossing, brought to life through engaging AR technology

left.title: Whole-Mouth Satisfaction Guaranteed
left.text: We are so confident you'll love our customized oral care solutions, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Experience the best in oral health—risk-free.
